game: JAX @ LV, Week 9 2025, kickoff 2025-11-02 16:05 ET, Allegiant dome, LV +2.5, total 43.5, moneyline not in pack, open-to-close move not in pack

script.base: Dome close game, not a blowout: JAX is only -2.5 with implied totals JAX 23.0 / LV 20.5. Starters should finish. Jacksonville's dropbacks concentrate on Brian Thomas Jr because Travis Hunter (24 targets, 180 yards, 192 air yards in weeks 5-7) and Tim Patrick are out. Las Vegas keeps Ashton Jeanty's carry role (43 carries, 163 yards in that window) but Jacksonville blitzes 33% and Las Vegas EPA/db is -0.24 when blitzed versus -0.04 when not, so the Raiders' 20.5 points come with negative plays and checkdowns rather than a clean Geno Smith rhythm.
script.flip1: Jacksonville leads by 10+ at half, Lawrence hands off to Etienne and Tuten to drain the clock, Thomas's air yards stall the way a clock-kill caps a QB (the 31-yard week-7 Thomas line is the template), and Las Vegas abandons the run so Jeanty's carries die while Tucker and Meyers targets rise late.
script.flip2: Las Vegas grabs the early home lead, Jacksonville throws to catch up, Etienne's carries die, Thomas and Washington air yards spike, and a mini-shootout pushes both teams through 23.0 and 20.5 so receiver overs cash together.

injury_fallout: Pre-kick nflverse report only; final inactives ~90 minutes before kick are not in the pack. JAX WR Travis Hunter Out (knee): 24 targets / 180 yards / 192 air in weeks 5-7, about 8 targets and 60 yards a game to redistribute. JAX WR Tim Patrick Out (groin): already absent from the week 5-7 target list, so the live WR room is Thomas, Parker Washington (17 tgt / 97 yds / 284 air) and Dyami Brown (13 / 78 / 189). JAX TE Quintin Morris Out (groin): Harold Long (7/38) and Johnny Mundt (7/30) were the week 5-7 TEs; Brenton Strange is on the board but not in that target list, so do not assign him Morris's or Hunter's share. JAX S Eric Murray Out (neck): missing safety, mild help to LV deep shots, not an offensive sleeper. JAX LB Devin Lloyd Questionable (calf): if he sits, second-level coverage on Jeanty softens; not confirmed, so not a requirement. LV S Lonnie Johnson Out (fibula): missing safety, helps Jacksonville deep shots into Thomas's 298 air yards. LV QB Aidan O'Connell Out (wrist): backup; Geno Smith is the week 5-7 QB/rusher (6 carries, 9 yards). Brock Bowers is not on the report and not in the week 5-7 target list (Mayer 9 targets, Okwuegbunam 6 were the TEs); week-9 snap share unverified, so no Bowers or Jeanty-checkdown leg.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone chart in the pack. Proxies: LV blitz 23%, YPA left 8.01 on 104 throws, middle 6.88 on 51, right 6.24 on 79. JAX blitz 33%, YPA left 7.16 on 100, middle 6.75 on 60, right 6.85 on 96.
matchup.pressure: Vegas blitzes only 23%. Jacksonville EPA/db is +0.10 when blitzed and -0.06 when not, so Lawrence's harder snaps are Vegas's base looks, not the blitz. Jacksonville blitzes 33%. Las Vegas EPA/db is -0.24 when blitzed and -0.04 when not, so pressure actually hurts Geno Smith and should cut deep LV WR yards while boosting RB/TE checkdowns.
matchup.bleeds: Vegas bleeds the left side (8.01 YPA) and has allowed 19 gains of 20+ passing for 249 yards in 7 games; rush defense is 4.12 YPC with 17 runs of 10+. Jacksonville's bleed is explosives more than a side: 24 gains of 20+ for 264 yards, YPA almost even, rush YPC allowed 4.24 with only 12 runs of 10+.
matchup.overlap: Thomas's 298 air yards in three games are the deep/left-side overlap, and LV S Lonnie Johnson is out. Washington's 284 air yards show the same area but he turned them into only 97 yards (5.7 yards/target), so the overlap is Thomas, not Washington. Jeanty's -23 air yards and 12 targets overlap the blitz-checkdown spot, but Bowers's unverified return blocks that leg. Meyers (10 targets, 71 yards in the window) does not attack a weak spot.

pro_edge.script_read: 43.5 is a modest total, so a slight under and run-lean prior, not a shootout volume-over slate. Spread is 2.5, not 3.5+, so the dog-throws-more flag is weak, and it is not a blowout, so starter snaps should finish. Mild favorite-runs-late prior lifts Etienne's carry risk and is the main threat to a rush under. A 23.0 team total can still produce a 50-yard WR1 day; it does not support stale 51.5 WR2 or 63.5 dog-RB rush lines by itself.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost because Vegas played a closed middle and bracketed Thomas once Hunter was inactive, the week-7 31-yard game was the template, and Lawrence's -0.06 EPA against unblitzed looks (Vegas blitzes only 23%) dumped short throws to Washington and Etienne instead of Thomas's air yards. Etienne cleared 56.5 because Jacksonville led by 10 at half, the favorite-runs-late prior showed up, he got 18 carries near the 4.12 YPC Vegas allows, and one of the 17-style explosives did what the 124-yard game already proved he can do. Both legs needed the close pass-lean script; the grind flip beat the read. A second miss path is week-8 form, which this pack does not have.
slip_story: One script: Hunter-less Jacksonville stays a pass-first road favorite in a close dome game (implied 23.0, total 43.5), so Thomas's receiving yards clear 49.5 and Etienne's 10.7-carry share never reaches the 15 he needs for 56.5. Those two win together in the base script and in the shootout flip. They lose together if Jacksonville leads big and grinds. Do not add a total under, a Jeanty over, or a Meyers number to this slip. Washington is the correlated sleeper, not a third leg. No TDs, no receptions, no passing yards. Max two players.
